svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Timeseries TTL 清理完整时序

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Timeseries TTL 清理完整时序
Latest values have a separate lifecycle.
same tenant/customer cursor and DELETE logic
and does not install a Timescale retention policy.
Scheduled cleanup is empty because history expiration
is attached to each Cassandra write.
Cassandra 写入时 TTL 生命周期
[system TTL is positive and request TTL is zero]
effective TTL = min(system TTL, request TTL)
INSERT history cell USING TTL effectiveTtl
effective TTL seconds after database write
Read invisibility is immediate at expiry,
but disk reclamation waits for compaction
still call row cleanup on a new connection
[row procedure raises SQLException or one-hour timeout]
catch and log, no in-run retry
process stops and JDBC connection closes
SYS partition may move to another Core node
There is no Kafka offset or cleanup job record.
Recovery is a later full scheduler invocation.
